pairs.subject: metric-forecasting
pairs.evidence: src/features/overview/libs/computeTrends.ts:2 The only trend code in this context compares two observed periods (backward-looking period-over-period deltas), and a search of src/features/overview/libs and components/shared for forecast, slope, extrapolat, leastSquares and horizon found no hits, so nothing here fits a line, projects a ray, or estimates a crossing date.

techniques.evidence: src/features/overview/libs/computeTrends.ts:22 A 'stable' band exists, but it applies to an observed period-over-period % change, not to a fitted slope or a projection horizon.
src/features/overview/libs/computeTrends.ts:124 The 'trend' is a ratio of two observed sums or averages. There is no regression and no projected ray.
src/features/overview/libs/computeTrends.ts:56 This gate refuses a comparison when there is no prior period. It does not gate a forecast; no forecast exists here.
